location_fine: mixed: apartment living room, bedroom, city street, tiled bathroom, village church exterior
visual_synopsis: This appears to be a COMPILATION of several unrelated sketches: three young men arguing in an apartment with a sepia flashback, then a man wrapped in head bandages and arm/leg plaster casts lying in bed beside his red-wigged wife (played in drag) while visitors come and go, then an outdoor funeral procession with a hearse, minibus and a crowd of mourners that ends in a street scuffle, then two men trading words in a tiled bathroom, and finally winter scenes with men in coats and knit hats outside an old stone church. Settings and casts are disjoint across the roughly 14-minute runtime.
